premise: Deactivating an n8n workflow does NOT kill already-running executions.
scope: Operational.dev executions that started before fence/deactivate during future cutover window

rules.reconcile: After fence, inventory running executions for Operational.dev; wait for completion or hard timeout; do not start new polls after deactivate

If Gmail message was read but Sheets/PG commit incomplete: treat as unfinished inbound. After PG_PRIMARY, reconcile by gmail_message_id stable key — do not rely on Sheets row numbers. Prefer PG commit then Gmail label; never label-before-commit on v3 path

Sheets write under old SoT is authoritative until CUTOVER_IN_PROGRESS final delta absorbs it. Ensure final delta includes that lead. Complete Gmail label under old workflow if still running; otherwise operator label after proving PG has the inbound
Do not send duplicate Telegram. After PG_PRIMARY, delivery outbox claim must be idempotent on delivery identity; historical Sheets deliveries absorbed by final delta
